Hey Babee 💋,

You are that favorite man of mine,
whom I didn’t just like… but slowly made a part of my habits, my happiness, and my prayers.

You probably have no idea what you mean to me. Your one little message can become the happiness of my entire day, your one voice can calm all the restlessness inside me, and your one smile can bring a smile to my face that nothing else in the world can.

You are not just a person to me.
You are a feeling that I can never completely put into words. With you, I never feel the need to pretend. In front of you, I want to remain exactly who I am — slightly stubborn, a little childish, sometimes very quiet, sometimes talking for no reason… because with you, I don’t have to hide who I am.

There is a strange kind of peace in your presence.
A kind of peace that I could probably search the whole world for, yet still never find anywhere else.

I like your little things more than your big gestures. The way you ask how I am, notice my silence, understand my anger, listen to my lectures, tease me, pamper me when I miss my home, and the biggest happiness when you come home after 3-4 days and hug me, kiss me, love me.

Sometimes, love is simply the reason a smile appears on your face when you hear someone’s name. ❤️

Happy birthday to my man who holds my heart. I love you more than words can say, today and always.

— Your babudii 🙈
